stepExplanation: AUG = Methionine (Met), GCU = Alanine (Ala), UAC = Tyrosine (Tyr), UGA = Stop. The polypeptide is **Met-Ala-Tyr** (3 amino acids).
stepBody: Using the genetic code provided, translate each codon to its amino acid. What is the amino acid sequence? (Remember: stop codons terminate translation)
